feedback.worked_solution:
Let $k(x)=\sqrt[3]{5x-10}.$ Let's sketch the graph of $y=k(x):$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13946716/assets/fee4cee6127ed4c12bc3c68260a6c21917734a44b60273448e68dd832270b0e5.png)

The graph shows that the function increases without bound as $x$ increases. Therefore,

$$
{lim}_{x\to \infty }k(x)=\infty .
$$
